title: Craftable Chorus flowers
description: This datapack add craft for Horus flower
body:
This Datapack craft сhorus flower for minecraft in survival 1.21.7-1.21.8
**How to craft **-> four chorus fruit, one apple!
This datapack ideal if you If you returned from the end and forgot to take the Horus flowers, but want to grow Horus fruits, now you can craft Horus flower.
[Recipe ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3ee96b5d40f3f52b06f6ddd35bf5672ef795faa.png)
